newsitem.title: USA: American Financial Enterprises net decreases.
newsitem.headline: American Financial Enterprises net decreases.

text.p: NOTE: American Financial Enterprises Inc (AFEI) said the extraordinary items reported were its proportionate share of affiliates' losses on prepayment of debt, net of tax.

As previously announced on April 23, the American Financial Group (AFG) said it has proposed a transaction whereby all 2.3 million shares of AFEI common stock not owned by AFG would be exchanged for AFG common stock on a share-for-share basis or $37.00 per AFEI share in cash. In light of this development, AFEI suspended accounting for its investment in AFG under the equity method in January 1997 and AFEI's first quarter results include dividends of $2.5 million received from AFG compared to equity in AFG's earnings of $8.6 million recorded in the first quarter of 1996.
In an April 23 story, AFG said it owned approximately 83 percent of AFEI's common stock. AFEI was not immediately available to comment on its relationship with AFG.
